generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the writing you are already doing. Every assignment you hand in is judged, in part, on whether it reads like the work of someone inside your subject. The conventions that judgement rests on are mostly unstated, yet your markers use them already. Learning to recognise and adopt them is how your writing starts to belong to the field. Treat what follows as being about your own essays and reports, not about writing in the abstract.

The same move carries into professional and research writing. Wherever you write for a field, your work is read partly for whether it sounds like an insider's. Learning to write within a discipline is a habit that keeps paying off long after you graduate.
